summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 8,000,000 ordinary shares (or pre-funded warrants in lieu) and warrants to purchase up to 8,000,000 ordinary shares at a combined price of $1.00 per share and warrant, with warrant exercise price of $1.15. Gross proceeds are ~$8 million, expected to close August 7, 2026. The filing also discloses an ongoing comprehensive impairment assessment of assets and goodwill, with potential material impact on Q2 2026 results. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as sole placement agent. Proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
